import pandas as pd
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
df = pd.read_csv('focus_billing.csv')
sub = df[(df['ChargeCategory']=='Usage') & (df['BillingPeriodStart'].astype(str).str.startswith('2026-08'))]

print(total)
print(total.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))
